LiteDB 5.0.21

Purpose: bundled read-only ALCOM project catalogue helper dependency.
Source: https://www.nuget.org/packages/LiteDB/5.0.21
License: MIT (see https://github.com/mbdavid/LiteDB/blob/v5.0.21/LICENSE)
Package SHA-256: 938a4f5f9d6a28383de8ccfcbdb8897e78432399215232cf38dbf147e03ec167

The release build must obtain the official package, verify this hash, and
extract only lib/net45/LiteDB.dll. The helper opens one explicitly supplied
database with LiteDB ReadOnly=true and does not write or migrate it.
